meta.name: build-agents-index
meta.description: Scan all agent and sub-agent definition files in .gaai/core/agents/, extract YAML frontmatter, merge with specialists.registry.yaml, and generate a derived agents-index.yaml at .gaai/core/agents/agents-index.yaml. Activate after adding, modifying, or removing any agent, sub-agent, or specialist entry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动扫描 agent 文件，生成最新索引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动维护 agent 索引文件
copy.tagline_en: Scan agent files and generate updated index automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to keep agent index up to date

howto.what: 当你在 .gaai/core/agents/ 目录下新增、修改或删除 agent、sub-agent 或 specialist 定义后，Claude 会自动扫描所有 .md 文件，提取 frontmatter 信息，并与 specialists.registry.yaml 合并，生成一个统一的 agents-index.yaml 索引文件。
howto.when: 在添加、修改或删除任何 agent、sub-agent 或 specialist 条目时，或当 agents-index.yaml 文件缺失或可能过时时自动触发。

say.text: 扫描所有 agent 并更新索引。
检查 agent 定义变动并刷新索引。
say.note: 仅在有变更时更新索引。

howto.what_en: After adding, modifying, or removing agent, sub-agent, or specialist definitions in .gaai/core/agents/, this skill scans all .md files, extracts YAML frontmatter, merges with specialists.registry.yaml, and generates agents-index.yaml as a derived catalog.
howto.when_en: Activated when an agent/sub-agent definition is created or modified, a specialist entry changes, or agents-index.yaml is absent/stale.

say_en.text: Scan all agents and update the index.

say_en.note: Force a refresh of the index file.

say_en.text: Check agent definition changes and refresh index.
